Got the cleaning gear! Time to scrub-a-dub-dub!
I got the cleaning tools! Let the cleaning spree begiiiin~!
I’m gonna rake in a ton of Mega Sphere Coins!
Come on, Mega Sphere Coins. Come to Mama!
Take to the stage! Get bigger and better!
Carry that into the holo Home!
Carry that into the holo Home! Let's go!
Sorry for making you lug that around!
Sorry you had to drag all that yourself~
Your help is much appreciated, matey.
Carrying that with friends was too easy!
Carrying that together took no time at all~♪
You saved the day~ Thank you!
You're such a bikk help, I mean it.
Great work. Let's set the baggage down.
Hey, hey! What's that you're holding?
So glad we got this cool decoration!
You brought coins, right? I spent all mine on gacha...

Thank you for coming to see me on stage today ♪ How is it? Are you enjoying it?
I’m having so much fun! I get to sing all my favorite songs under such a beautiful blue sky!
Look, look! A rainbow ♪
Could it be that my singing made a rainbow appear~? Then I will make an even bigger one!
I’d be so happy if you could follow me all the way to the end, just like racing through that blue sky!
Let’s go! Nun nun ♪

You guys! I'll keep running...
We'll keep running...
Do you like this design? It looks like I trapped the sky in my outfit ♪
Hmm, what kind of set list should I go for~? I’d better start planning it right now!
Being able to do what I do isn’t something to take for granted... I really need to be thankful to everyone who supports me ♪
Pffft! I thought it was a microphone, but it was a water bottle... Do not laugh at me please ♪
Will you come to the next concert too? It’s a promise, okay?! Let’s pinky swear so you don’t forget ♪

Woohoo! Did you see that? Did you? I won again!
Well, could you really expect anything else from someone as high-spec as me?
All right, let's keep this winning streak alive! Let's make a new Roboco legend! Woohoo!
Are you watching? 'Cause I'm gonna show you something totally wild, hehe!
Hey, wait?! Why did the game start on its own?!
Ugh, don't do that! Oh nooo! My winning streak!

This moment we shared is a gift... 
Thank you, from the bottom of my heart!
Well? Well? Am I sexy? Am I?
Don't you just love my pink coat? And what could be hiding underneath... Hehe, so naughty!
Gotta train my gaming muscles if I'm gonna set a new Roboco legend! Here we go!
Phew, I'm pooped... Maybe a few head pats would help re-energize me... Meow!
Thanks for always supporting me through my special training. I'll give you a head pat as thanks!

Oh? I wasn't expecting a visitor this deep in the woods... Or maybe...you're lost?
You'd better watch out, or the big bad half-elf is gonna get you! Ahaha, just kidding!
Ahaha, sorry. Don't mind me. And come on, don't just stand there. Wanna go for a quick dip?
The water's nice and refreshing! Huh? No, don't be embarrassed. What's there to be embarrassed about?
Come on... Let me wash those nerves away!
Thank you for falling in love with me!
Wanna see my moves? I can perform your very own little forest musical.
Hey... Were you fawning over the back of me just now?
Phew! All that dancing has got me pooped! I'd say it's time for drinks now. Who's game?
I just...feel better with you around. Won't you stay with me...a little while longer?
Are you sleepy? Don't worry, you can rest your head in my lap. Here, it's ready for you, hehe!

Haachama-chama♪ Your guard is down! Here goes! Haachama’s special choco attack!
Here you are. I brought you tons of chocolate☆
They are all made by yours truly, so there’s nothing to worry about♪
Huh? Of course there’s nothing weird mixed in!
Hmmm... Maybe just a lil’ bit? I just poured lots of love, you silly! But I will not tell you the ingredients love is made of♪
C’mon! Open your mouth!
Say “ahh” for me♪

You all make me so happy—
I want this to last forever!
How’s this new look!? Ain’t me the cutest thing around!?
Hmm, it seems you won’t open your mouth no matter what... Don’t make me go all “open sesame” on you!
See? It’s a totally normal and tasty chocolate, right? You’re really such a worry-wart♪
Since I gave you chocolate, NOW I am supposed to get something in return, okay?♪
I know what I want! I want YOU to continue eating my cooking...FOREVER! I’ve go you covered!♪

What's this? A wayward soul wandering in sacred grounds?
Heh heh... You look like you'd go down in one gulp...
Pft... PAHAHAHA!!! No, no, I kid! I'm not a fox spirit, I'm just Fubuki!
Heh, you should have seen your face... This fox mask really paid off, haha!
Come on, let's get going to the festival. There's so much I wanna do!
I wanna eat the candied apples, the takoyaki, the taiyaki, the fried chicken... You know what? Let's just visit all the stalls!
We're gonna have all the fun today! Woohoo!

We're all here today all thanks to you.
Let's keep shooting for the stars!
What a gorgeous kimono! And it's even got my favorite flowers on it.
Yummy yummy takoyaki! Oh? Nope! Look at me with those puppy dog eyes all you want, but you're not having any!
Ugh, it's so hot... Shall we make a stop by that shaved ice vendor?
Oh, you wanna see who shoots better? Heh heh heh... Challenge accepted!
Thanks for coming to the festival with me today! Oh man, it was so much fun! Let's...do this again, yeah?

You were staring at Matsuri’s dance just now, weren’t you? Have you fallen for me yet?
You were supposed to be cheering, but you I got you mesmerized instead! What a naughty boy you are... ♪
Ah, halftime’s about to end. I’ll head back out! Let’s give our best together ♪
Oh, and it’s completely fine if you want to keep up whatever you were doing! ♪
If our eyes happen to meet, I’ll give you plenty of fanservice ♪

Thank you for all your love and support. 
Let the festivities continue!
Well, what do you think? I am so à la mode today! ♪
If you’re feeling down, tell me, okay? My cheers will surely boost your spirit a thousandfold ♪
Go, go ♪ Don’t give up ♪ Don’t give up ♪ Fight onnnn! ♪
Phew, it’s so hot~ I wonder if someone would wipe my sweat off me. *glances at you*
You’re cheering Matsuri on too much! Geez, I can’t help but smile back~ ♪

Woah! It’s so pretty and magical!
To think such a place existed... I’m so glad we made a little detour!
*sniff sniff sniff* Something smells really nice~ Ah, the smell came from my flowers all along. Hehe…
Thanks for picking out these flowers for me ♪ I’ll make sure to display them carefully when I get back to my room ♪
But before that… Wanna explore around here a bit more? Really? Yay!
Alright then! Should we start with that path? Or maybe this one? Hmm, decisions decisions... Eeny, meeny, miny, moe, catch a demon by the toe, eeny, meeny, miny, moe ♪
I'm gonna do my best so you all know just how grateful I am!
Quiz time! How many butterflies are on this kimono? The answer is…a bunch of them!
Did you like my quizmono? Ahahaha!
Sorry, were you saying something? I didn’t catch any of it.
Urk! A full moon! My demon power is...not awakening anytime soon ♪
Y-Yeah, let’s head home… Um, hey! Will you go out with me again sometime?

Ahhh... This feels so good!
I went to the beach the other day, and there's just nothing like lying on a float.
*sigh* I could laze around forever...
Hm? Shaved ice? ...Shaved ice?! Of course I'll eat it! Let’s go get some!
Gah... Ugh, this float just won't move! This is so annoying!
...Eh? Oh, I know! I can just get off the float and walk!
Ehehe... And off. Okay, let’s go!

Gonna party with us until the very end? 
Ehehe, it’ll be our summer promise!
How's my swimsuit? Does it suit me? ...Ehehe, thanks!
Wow, shaved ice! Hm... Aaaah! Brain freeze!
Hey, wait! I just realised... If you inflate a beach ball, it becomes a pillow...
*pants* It’s not inflating at all... Eh? ...There’s a pump?! Why didn't you say so?!
I did it... Hey, hey, let's grab a beach ball and go bob it around!

Jeez, you’re such a needy one ♪ You really wanted to sleep together that badly? ♪
Sure thing♪ I will pamper you a whole lot♪ *headpats*
Haha, you look so happy! Did you want headpats that badly?
Aren’t you nodding a bit too much? Your eyes are really sparkling too.
Oh my, you’re way too honest with what you want.
Alright, that’s it for today! But we’ll continue…another time, okay? ♪

I'm only here thanks to you guys! 
Here's to many more years together!
A new outfit really gets me hyped ♪ I’m heading out to play!
Maybe this sexy devil will go ahead and corrupt everyone for funsies~♪
Morning... Just a bit more... G’nite...
Satisfy my curiosity… What have you been looking at this whole time? ♪
Thanks for always waking me up... I really appreciate it…♪

So cold~ Hey you guys, quit flapping your wings already!
Jeez, my clothes got wet. But hey, with a weather this nice, they’ll dry in no time ♪
What are you doing over there!? Come over here and hang out with us!
Ah, wait! We’ll come over there! Alright everyone, gather up!
Stop quacking and making a fuss, alright? From here, we’re going to race to over there!
Here we go! Three, two… Go, go, go! Hahaha!

You guys made me the idol I am today! 
Let's make tomorrow sparkle even more!
Oversized clothes are definitely the way to go! What do you think? Isn’t it cute?
See this patch? It’s Subaru’s favorite!
I found a really great song! Here—headphones! Give it a go!
This hat is pretty cool, right? Wanna go buy a matching set together? ♪
Hiya! Are you free right now? Wanna go hang out!? I’ll go wherever you want!

This is sooo nice! The seaside is the best!!!
What do you want to do? I had fun floating around last time, wanna do that?
Wha...? Heeeeey! Why are you the only ones with lifesavers!
That is not fair! I will bring a lifesaver too! Give me a minute. Hooooaaawaaaa?!
I think I dropped my sunglasses in the ocean?!
Don’t be floating around like nothing is happening! Help me look for them!

Get loud, play around, and laugh along with me! 
Let's enjoy summer!
It is really easy to move around in a swimsuit! Hehe!
I won't let a little water resistance beat me! Full on dash! Wooooooah!
Break time, break time~♪ And my towel is...oh snap! I forgot my towel!
Thank you for the towel! You really saved me! As a thank you, I will give you some shaved ice! Here!
The wind feels so nice~♪ Why are you staring at me like that...? I’m getting embarrassed...

Are you having fun, everyone~?!
Singing surrounded by petals... What a great atmosphere!
And being surrounded by so many cheers like this… AZKi is truly happy ♪
Don’t forget to stay hydrated, ‘cause we are headed into the second half of the concert!
If you get tired, make sure to take a proper break, okay? It’s a promise with AZKi!
This is my next song!
I’ll sing with all my heart so it reaches everyone!
With you all by my side, I feel like the sky's the limit!
I’ve started flower arrangement... What do you think of it?
Pffft! I’ve found plenty of smiles! ♪
I’ll sing with all my heart, so please, don’t take your eyes off AZKi!
The concert isn’t over until you get home! Make sure to take lots of memories of AZKi with you!
Thank you so much for always supporting me! Let’s keep making a beautiful world together ♪

What do you think about this place? It has a nice atmosphere, it’s quiet, stylish, and the view is great.
It’s the perfect place to talk at a relaxed pace, right? Hey, what’s wrong? You look kinda tense.
Are you nervous? Oh, come to think of it, didn’t you say this kind of place is a first for you?
Okay, no worries! I’ll take the lead today!
You just need to relax!
I guess that’s not so easy right away, huh? Well, for now, let’s just make a toast ♪

We don't need no crystal balls to see the fun 
we're about to have!
Isn’t this outfit a little too mature for me? I‘m not really sure it suits me...
Dining out at night just feels so special... But homemade meals at home are nice too ♪
If you want, I can listen to your concerns, since we’re next to each other anyways ♪
I see. You’ve been through a lot and you did your best. *headpats*
Thanks a lot for today. I’m lucky to have spent such a fun time ♪

W-Whoa! The cherry blossoms are in full bloom... And they're all Miko's color!
You wanted me to see it! And here I was thinking you wanted to go shrine hopping all of a sudden.
Well, isn't this a nice surprise! Hey, I'm not crying, you are! Teehee!
Well, seeing as we're here, let's go sit under the flowers! Under their radiant and dazzling blooms.
Ah! Pahahaha! You've got a petal on your head. No, a bit more to the right...
Oh, here. Let me just get it for you. Hold still... Okay, got it!

From here on out, I'll keep making countless smiles bloom! 
Everyone, follow my lead!
Check me out! Outfit in full bloom!
Miko's elite levels are goin' on up! Well come on, say something!
Ey! Ain't nobody gonna call Miko a baby now!
Ooh, look at you! You're just infatuated with me!
I've got a place for us next time we go out. It's a date!

Miko-chan peeeeeew!!! Yes, yes, yes! I hit it! Yes!
Hehehe! I will keep going and decimate Sui-chan’s team!
Oh, what? I am all of a sudden surrounded by the enemy team...
Don’t you point those water guns at me! Are you not ashamed of ganging up on me like this?
...Ah. I was just joking... I would very much appreciate it if you'd lower your water guns...
Ah...ah.. Aaaaaaaaaargh!!!

Let’s get wet head to toe 
and enjoy this summer show together!
Hey, I look good in this swimsuit, no? Hehehe!
Like, sunglasses are part of any grown-up’s essentials, obviously.
Nice, nice, nice! Good moves!♪ Destroy all enemies!
Oh no! They’re gonna get me! Someone please be my shield!
Oooh, oh... Thank you for covering up for me back there! I will protect you now, promise!

Been working hard today? Ahaha, do you need a shoulder rub?
I mean, you are always helping out so much with the store.
As thanks, let me make the stresses of the day fade away...
What would you like? A massage? Shoulders? Or a full-body massage?
I'll rub anything you want. Ahaha, your face has gone bright red!
Were you thinking naughty thoughts? Hehe... Come on. This place won't clean itself up.
Oh, but I wanna hear what sort of massage you want before we're done, okay?
All right, lean in close... I LOVE YOU ALL!!
Ta-da! It's Nekomata Okayu in maid form, here to prank your butt!
I've got just the thing for your omelet rice today... Moe moe kyun!
Oh please? Won't you be my master?
You can do it! You can do it! Go, go, master!
I LOVE being together with my master! Please don't ever let me go!

Sorry for the wait! Here is your order!
What? You didn’t order this much? Everything except the parfait is on the house!
It’s a little more than I intended...but, well, you can still eat it, RIGHT?
Oh, by the way. My recommendation is...everything! Ahaha! Because they're all unbelievably delicious!
Just one bite and your cheeks will feel like you’re doing a bungee jump! Come on, eat up~
Thanks so much for spending the day with me! I love you!
How about this frilly outfit~? Cute, right?
Behold my splendid saleswoman power! Yeah ♪
Feel free to order as much as you like! With these shoes carrying trays is a breeze...
Huh? Are you trying to order from another person that’s not me? Huh? HUH?
Thanks for ordering so much. I hope you order from me again... ‘Cause if I not...I’ll look for you.

Time flies when you're having fun! It's sad it has to end, but this is the last song!
Thanks to all of you, we had such a great show!
All those penlights waving in the dark makes the hall look like a starry night sky!
Every single one of you is a shining star to me! I want my voice to reach all of you!
Don't take your eyes off me! I'll show you just how bright I can shine!
I don't want to hear that I was too bright to see, okay?

I'll keep going, and if you'll keep giving me your support, 
that's all I need!
I'm loving the cool colors. Aren't they great?
Sparkle sparkle!☆ I'm shining super bright, wrapped in the night sky!
Hydration is important! Let's work towards our goals together!
Are you ready, everyone? Scream loud enough to reach the stars!
Thank you for coming today! I'll keep singing my heart out for you!

Everyone, gather! We’re gonna have a battle with a team led by Sakura Miko.
Our team’s objective is absolute victory! Do not fret and strike the enemy with your water guns!
If you got it, yell! Yaaaaay!
I am shaking with excitement! I want to see Mikochi’s face fill with terror when I take her down with my water gun!
I want to hear her screams already!
Oh, we're about start! Here we go! Charge! YEAAAAAAH!

It’s so hot! But I’m having so much fun!♪ 
Let’s make the most out of this summer!
These sunglasses are cool, huh? Don’t you dare stand behind me! Just kidding~☆
I will not stand back! Tremble before HOSHIMACHI!
Thank you for backing me up! I will not forget this! I will always have your back!☆
The victory for our team is near! Make Mikochi kneel before us!
Here, a soft drink. You did a great job today. Thank you!☆ Let’s hang out again!

Mwa ha ha ha... Complete at last, peko!
Behold! The Pekorization is complete! As of this moment, this place shall now be known as... Pekoland 2!
Now to pekorize the next place, and the next, and soon the entire world will belong to Peko-ra! Peeeko peko peko!
Huh...? I'm being invoiced? You mean I gotta foot the bill?
Let's see... HAAAHH?!?! Isn't that too many zeroes?! Waah, I'm gonna go broke!
What a rip off! I've been totally screwed!

You heard it here, folks! 
This is the beginning of our Pekora Story!
All wrapped up in a pretty blue ribbon! Hey, aren't I just the cutest gift?
I've got a new rule for Pekoland... Well, just use your common sense!
I've got a new plan! Heehee, this is just between you and me, peko!
I need your help for my new plan, peko! You won't wanna miss this, I promise, peko!
Thank you... um... for always having my back, peko!

Um, thank you for joining us here today on a boat tour of the island oceanic sights. I’ll be your guide, Shiranui Flare.
How was that? Pretty convincing? So, the boat will soon pass under the bridge coming up ahead...
Huh? We stopped. Did paddling wear you out?
Sorry, sorry. I left you in charge of it, I’ll tag in for you.
In exchange, can you guide in my place for me? Hehehe.
Oh, you wanna paddle instead? Shame, I wanted to see act as my guide, hahaha.

Thank you so much for supporting me. 
I'm so glad we met, and I love you all.
What do you think of my outfit, today? It’s frilly and cute, right?
A pigeon is here! I wonder, did they come to greet us?
Oh, look in the water... Oh! That was close, I leaned out too far!
Hey, let's head toward town when we disembark. I still want to go sightseeing together.
Let’s go look at more landscapes. We already promised we would, right?

The sun has gone down. I guess it's time for that thing. Ta-da! Fireworks!
I wanted to do them last time we came to the beach. Here, there are many so you can pick any.
I will have this one and this one. Let’s light them together! One, two...
Oh, look! It is so pretty!
Behold! A double firework wielder! Just kidding!
Oh, that one is the color-changing type. That's nice... Let me hold it for a bit.
Don’t let the heat beat you! I will give you all my energy!
I decided to place some sunflowers around since it's summer. Nice, huh?
I am right here! Try and catch me! Ahaha~♪ You ended up falling down! Are you alright?
I just found some pretty shells! Since I found two, I’ll give you one!
The sparklers are the best to finish. Whoever drops it first has to pay for ice creams afterwards.
That was really moving, hehe. Thank you, it’s become a lovely summer memory.

Wah, are you okay?! You must be shocked to suddenly trip like that?
You’re not injured, right? ...Yeah, you seem to be fine.
Good! That’s a relief. Oh, but your knee is turning red.
In times like this... There, there. See, makes the pain all go away!
Hehehe... Now just stand back up!
Here, take Dancho’s hand. You can put your weight on me.
...And there you go! Wh-Wh-What?! Oh dear... Now Dancho fell over too LOL

I'll keep training, keep levelling, 
so we can all reach peak joy!
How's this outfit? Does it make your Dancho look tough?
Next time you feel you’re about to fall over, bring your foot out and plant it firmly on the ground!
Oh, wow! You’ve walked a distance but you’re still full of energy! Nice stamina.
Eh, you’re giving Dancho water? Thanks! This will blow away the aches!
Thanks accompanying on a walk today! Let’s go again some time!

Heeeey, what are you doing? Come over here and let’s take a dip in the sea!
Ah, there you are! Here, sit. Feels nice, right?
Everytime the waves come at me, I feel like it's tickling my waists!♪
I was moving around a lot last time, so it’s also nice to take it easy like this, too~♪
Wha..? Whooooa!
Oh, that wave crashed right over my head... Hehehe, I'm completely soaked.
Well, now that's happened... Why don’t we have a water fight~?

Let’s enjoy summer together this year, 
and the next, and also the one after that!
You are staring at me so much! Do you perhaps like my swimsuit look?
My speed is boosted in the swimsuit! Look at my steps! Yay, yay, yaaay!
A soft serve ice cream at the beach is just something else. Oh, no! It will spill!
Hey, hey! Let’s lie on a floaty and just drift around.
Lying down like this makes us really close. Kind of exciting, hehe.

The sky is as clear as it gets, and the breeze is perfect. Truly a perfect day for sailing~♪
Today our goal is a no-man island southwest, heading toward treasure we've never seen, yohoho!
Hey hey ♪ Are you paying attention at your captain’s captains~?
My plump tights, maybe? Or my world-famous body?
You should be focused doing deck work instead of thinking with it, you bad boys.
With that said, make sure to come to the captain's room later!
Some one sure is in need of correction! ♪

Swear it on your life, your soul, your lips... 
Forever, and only me!
Iyaan ♡ Even though the captain’s sexy, aren’t you staring a little too much ☆
Hnnnn ♪ My pants are super tight~ ♪
Oh no! My chest feels soo tight! My clothes are about to burst off!
To think you’d do this to me ♡ With you, I can go anywhere ♡
I'm sorry, my crewmates. My clothes didn’t burst off, but my heart has. Please, do as you like with the captain ♡

Welcome to Watame’s concert~ ♪ Are you enjoying it? Getting hyped? Are you feeling the Watavibes?
What amazing cheer power! Everyone's expressions are shining just like the sun ♪
Seeing everyone’s smiles makes me teary... But no, no! It’s TOO soon to cry!
After all, the concert has just begun! Alright, everyone, are you ready?
Let’s unite our hearts together as one! We’re gonna have fun and become one big, big family!

Thank you! 
You'll keep making dreams come true with me, right?
Do you like this outfit? It’s all so fluffy and cute...just like me!
There’s so many green in this, its like an all-you-can-eat buffet of green!
Raise both hands~ Swing them left and right~ Then stretch them both and get pumped!
Wh-What an incredible sense of unity! Is this the power of our bond?
No one can take anyone's place! Everyone is an important part of Watame’s family!

Aaaah... Floating in the sea like this sure is nice!
I enjoyed floating around when we last came. I could get used to this.
Another thing I can get used to is...this!
Hahaha, that was my chance. You should've been paying attention.
Don't blame me... Hmpf...!
Ugh,,, I'm soaking wet! So that is how it is, huh? Take this! Ahahaha!

Everyone! Let’s make this a great summer memory together! 
Have a nice day~♪
Ehehe, do you think this swimsuit suits me? Oh, you’ve turned red all of a sudden!
I am hungry~! Someone feed me! *glances*
Yummy! Curry by the sea is really something else. Thank you for buyin’ it!
What should we do next? Have a swim? I will show you my well-honed swimming skills!♪
Woah, a sunset at the beach! It is so beautiful! Let’s come together to watch this scene again!

Yess!! Number 1, baby! You see that?!
That was insane, right? You've never seen god-tier aiming like that before!
How'd you do? Hey, not bad!
You said this was your first time, right? You're killing it!
Phew! Okay let's take a breather and then jump right back in!
You and I are gonna dominate every last leaderboard!
Thanks a mill, groupies! Let's keep it free and easy!
Hey! I'm totally rocking this outfit, right?
What're you staring at? You're asking for a fine!
Oh you wanna play games do you? Bring it on!
GG! Have some water. Let's play again soon.
Thanks for always hanging out... It's...fun.

Are you still not ready? I’m tired of waiting already...
...Hm? You want me to help too? But weren’t you guys the ones to say let's have a party?
Then you guys should be treating me like a guest!
Plus with all of you there, it’ll be a beautiful party! See, Nnatan doesn’t have a single thing to do!
Now you understand that, do your best, everyone! Quickly now!
Will you please stay by my side forever and ever?
When you think of Nnatan, you think pink, right? Suits me, right?
A girl this cute should be complimented more. Tch...
Wanna take a picture with me? Say cheese...!
Are you glad to be coming to a party with me? Hehehe.
This is the kind of party I like. Keep on serving me like this!

Aaah, I’ve had plenty of time to relax. It’s time to play in the sea, nora!
So, could you inflate my float, nora.
...Eh? There’s no air pump, nora? It's quite all right. A float of this size should be easy to inflate, nora?
I’ve inflated a plastic pool before, so I can show you the trick, nora!
Like this, nora? Then with all your might, puff out your cheeks and... Pfffffft! Got it, nora? Well, off you go, nora.

Let’s blow away the summer heat together, nora! 
Ready, nora? Pfffft!
Ta-da! Isn't this swimsuit cute? Here comes the Summer Princess, nora!
Floating in the sea like this sure is nice, nora! Mmmm...
You’re commendable for keeping a close eye on me and making sure I didn’t get whisked away, nora! A pat on the back for you, nora!
Huh?! Did you just splash water on me, nora...? You! You! Come back here!
Today was fun, nora! I’m glad we could make summer memories together, nora!
